Weapon Lvl is this gun's level. Unlocks carry over to compatible guns, so a part you've already unlocked on another gun is ready to use.
Tier: sources disagree
Our main stat tracker rates it "Contender" after the Oct 28 update, which cut its neck and upper-chest damage. A second stat tracker puts it in its A tier.
Build: sources disagree
We list our main stat tracker's top Multiplayer build, which it changed for Season 1 on Nov 6. A second stat tracker's Versatile build (Oct 22) shares the HAN 86 Silenced 413mm and FSS Tac90 Grip, and runs the Schlager Visiv-5, SZ Prima-4 Dot and Meiko L9P-Fold instead. It hasn't changed that build since Season 1.
Apex details: one source so far
Only the official weapons post says a direct hit is a dud.

Apex attachment · Lvl 72
Han X20 Skybreaker
Adds a 20mm airburst launcher with its own targeting optic: you mark a spot in range and the shell bursts in the air above it, which flushes enemies out of cover. A direct hit is a dud. Recoil drops by about 30%, but aiming gets slower. It blocks optics, barrels and stocks, so drop those from either build to run it.
Unlocks at weapon max level and doesn't take one of your five attachment slots.
